Orange blend Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Lucy
rows.Origin: Bred by Gordon Wilson Kirkham (United Kingdom, 2001).
rows.Bloom: Orange blend. Orange with yellow center. In small clusters bloom form.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders or container rose. Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
